title: Correctness of the junta constant test
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ depend on at most $k$ coordinates. If a rational estimate $a$ differs by less than $\eta_k=1/(2^{k+2})$ from the mean of $f$ on the uniform sign cube, then the following test returns the correct classification: declare $f$ identically $1$ when $1-2\eta_k<a$, declare it identically $-1$ when $a<-(1-2\eta_k)$, and otherwise declare it nonconstant.
hypotheses_covered: The absolute difference between $a$ and the uniform mean of $f$ is less than $1/2^{k+2}$
